root_idea.summary: The root centers on scraping or removing a surface, with related branches for emission or resonant sound and for making something proceed swiftly or continuously.
root_idea.development: The concrete branch extends from scraping, filing, and abrading to filings, stripped surfaces, whitened cloth, and the shore understood as abraded by water. Other established branches concern braying or pouring forth, fluent continuity, and hastening or ready payment.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic noun is best presented under the normalized citation form سَاحِلٌ.

senses.definition: The shore or bank of the sea.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression بِالسَّاحِلِ, it denotes the sea-shore or water's edge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pare, peel, scrape, abrade, file, or otherwise remove an outer covering or surface; of wind, to strip the surface of the earth; of clothes, to wash them by beating off their soils.
To strike someone a hundred lashes or strokes, figuratively as though paring off the skin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional figurative use of the surface-removal sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To revile, blame, or speak evil of someone, including behind the person's back or in the person's absence.
To bruise, bray, pound, or pulverize a thing.
To smooth pieces of money; also, according to variant explanations, to pour them out or examine them in order to separate the good from the bad.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with coins or pieces of money.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pay money in ready cash.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in constructions meaning to pay someone a specified sum, or to pay a creditor a specified sum.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To weave cloth from spun thread that is not formed of two twists, or to weave without twisting the warp into double-twisted threads.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This textile construction is distinct from the noun denoting an unplied garment, thread, or rope.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pour forth; of the sky, to pour down rain; of the eye, to pour forth tears or weep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sky and eye usages are conventional extensions of pouring forth liquid.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an ass, to make a rolling sound in the chest or to bray.
To go or bring someone or something to the shore.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form III verb is used of coming to, or bringing a caravan to, the shore.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contend, dispute, or litigate with someone.
To find a person being reviled, blamed, or spoken about maliciously by others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction presents the object as the person against whom such speech is directed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become pared, peeled, scraped, abraded, or stripped of an outer covering or superficial part.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may be said of the surface of the earth when wind strips away what is upon it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of pieces of money, to become smooth.
To pour forth, or to become poured forth.
Of a she-camel, to be or become quick and swift in going.
Of an orator, to run on in speech fluently, diffusely, and without pause or hesitation.
A white garment or piece of cloth, especially a white cotton garment associated with Yemen.
A garment, thread, or rope made with a single yarn or strand rather than two twists.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The terminology contrasts with a material made from two twists or two strands.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ready money or cash.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An infinitive used substantively.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who beats, washes, and whitens clothes.
The rolling sound in an ass's chest or the vehement braying of a wild ass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the sound rather than the act of braying.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Filings or scrapings, especially filings of gold, silver, or another substance, and the husks or particles stripped from grains in pounding or braying.
The refuse or lowest, basest, or meanest portion of a people or party.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative collective use derived from discarded scrapings or husks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A white cotton garment or cloth associated with سَحُول, a place in Yemen, or described as beaten, washed, and whitened.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nisbah or related designation; variant vocalizations are reported in the lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The bank of a great river, the cultivated tract adjoining a sea or great river, or the side of a valley.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are broader Classical extensions of the shore or water-edge noun beyond the Quranic sea-shore use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tree resembling tamarisk, growing in soft or plain tracts and used for its twigs as tooth-cleaning sticks.
Water-courses or places in which water flows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural form whose singular is not specified in the cited entry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An implement for cutting, hewing, or paring wood; a file.
The tongue, especially a ready, eloquent, or fluent tongue; by extension, an orator or good speaker.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The speaker usage emphasizes speech that scarcely stops.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person skilled in reading or reciting the Quran.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional designation connected with continuous or fluent recitation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Copious rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun associated with pouring forth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A water-spout whose forceful outflow cannot readily be resisted.
The mouth of a leather water-bag.
A brisk or lively waterer or cup-bearer.
Extreme in bounty or munificence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use describing a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A courageous man who acts, charges, or attacks alone.
A flogger who inflicts punishments prescribed by law before or in the presence of the Sultan.
A component of a bridle or bit, including the iron fitting or paired rings at the ends of the bit-mouth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact fitting varies across technical descriptions of the bridle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Error or waywardness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the idiom of following or entering into one's error.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Decisive resolution or determination, together with energetic exertion in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in idioms describing a person's resolve and determined effort.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Energetic continuation in discourse, a sermon, speech, or poetry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The idiomatic use describes proceeding forcefully and continuously in verbal composition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The side or lower part of the beard, the place of the sideburn, the temple, or the side of the cheek.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The dual form may denote the corresponding two sides.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A clean, thin cotton garment or piece of cloth.
A rope, string, or thread twisted by itself as a single strand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A strand made with another strand is classified differently in the cited textile terminology.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sieve.
The wild ass; also an active or brisk ass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The epithet is associated with the animal's braying and energetic movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A low, vile, mean, or sordid man.
A devil.
The name of the familiar jinni or genie associated with the poet al-Aʿshā.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name usage rather than a general lexical designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ball of spun thread.
A road, understood as abraded by the feet of people and beasts.
An even, wide place.
A small and contemptible man.
The name of a camel belonging to the poet al-ʿAjjāj.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perform a reading or recitation in consecutive portions, continuously.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to recitation; the associated verbal noun سَحْلٌ denotes making a thing consecutive in its parts or portions.
